items.difficulty_reason: Two-direction comparison: the I-adic topology is finer via IF^n ⊂ F^{n+1}; the converse uses finite generation of the graded module ⊕E_n, generators a_i ∈ F^{c_i}, and the open mapping lemma applied to the continuous map (F^n)^⊕r → F^{n+1}.
